scenario: Munger rice smallholder demo memory palace

observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: Soil health card showed low potassium and medium organic carbon before transplanting.
observations.outcome: Farmer applied muriate of potash and farmyard manure before first irrigation.
actions: Use soil test results before adding more urea.
Split potassium application instead of applying only nitrogen.
warnings: Do not apply extra urea when leaves are already lush green.

observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: Brown oval spots appeared on lower rice leaves after cloudy humid weather.
observations.outcome: Drainage was improved and infected leaves did not spread after seven days.
actions: Scout lower leaves every two days for expansion of oval brown spots.
Improve drainage and avoid water stress.
warnings: Do not spray fungicide without confirming disease spread or extension-worker advice.

observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: Stem borer moth trap count rose but dead-heart symptoms stayed below economic threshold.
observations.outcome: Farmer continued monitoring instead of applying insecticide immediately.
actions: Check 20 random hills for dead hearts before any pesticide decision.
Use light trap observations as a warning signal, not as the only trigger.
warnings: Avoid calendar-based insecticide sprays when pest pressure is below threshold.

observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: Farmer asked whether to spray before forecast rain and flowering.
observations.outcome: Spray was postponed because rain was expected and flowering was approaching.
actions: Spray only in low wind and no-rain windows if spraying is actually needed.
Keep pre-harvest interval and pollinator safety in mind.
warnings: Do not spray during flowering or before rain unless the label and extension worker allow it.

observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: Mandi modal price for paddy was below MSP; farmer considered delaying sale.
observations.outcome: Farmer planned partial sale and checked FCI procurement documents.
actions: Compare local mandi modal price with MSP before sale.
Prepare land record, Aadhaar, bank passbook, and crop details for procurement.
warnings: Do not distress-sell the full harvest when MSP channel is available and storage is safe.
